issue.title: Mobile API integration & initial data sync
issue.body:
## Overview
Wire up manual sync on the home screen: auth header, fetch sequence, 
SQLite upserts, MMKV state, and inline sync status. Sync is manual 
trigger only for now.

## Shared context

### .env
USER_ID=00
USER_EMAIL=user@fluent.com

### MMKV keys
| Key | Value | Set when |
|-----|-------|----------|
| `userId` | `00` | App startup (from env) |
| `userEmail` | `user@fluent.com` | App startup (from env) |
| `sync_count_projects` | `5` | After sync |
| `sync_count_chapters` | `12` | After sync |
| `sync_count_bibles` | `3` | After sync |
| `last_synced_at` | `2024-01-04T10:32:00Z` | After sync |
| `sync_error_<step>` | `"Network timeout"` | On step failure |

### Upsert strategy (all tables)
Use `INSERT OR REPLACE` keyed on server `id`. After each upsert, compare 
new row count vs previous count and store in MMKV as `sync_count_<table>`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] After first launch, `users` table has exactly 1 row
- [x] After first sync, `languages`, `books`, `bibles`, `projects`, 
      `project_units`, `chapter_assignments` and `bible_texts` are all populated
- [x] Re-running sync does not duplicate rows
- [x] A failing step does not crash or block other steps
